name: android-control-mcp
description: Self-installing Android phone control MCP server, packaged as a Claude Desktop extension (.mcpb)

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=bundle/server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --minify-syntax --legal-comments=none && node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE','THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md']) require('fs').copyFileSync(f, 'bundle/' + f)"
scripts.pack: npm run build && mcpb pack bundle android-control-$npm_package_version.mcpb
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/match.test.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs
